title: Create languageDifficulty.ts utility with FSI multipliers
description: Create a utility file that maps languages to difficulty multipliers based on FSI rankings. Standard (1.0x): Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch. Hard (1.5x): Hebrew, Persian/fa, Russian, Hindi. Super-Hard (2.0x): Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Chinese/Mandarin.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DIFFICULTY_MULTIPLIERS constant maps language codes to multipliers
Handles case-insensitive language codes (persian, Persian, fa all work)
